title: 第9章 不经打击老天真屡受打击必成神第10章 教育要从娃娃抓起不能输在起跑线上
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
一进入系统，就先听到老毕登的声音“大哥，大哥，你终于来了，我都等了你多少天了，你怎么才来？，小鸳鸳的小内内你没有挂在窗户上吗，我怎么还是出不去？大哥，大哥，我想我的小鸳鸳啊。”
“你的小鸳鸳？不可无理，以后你要叫青鸳嫂嫂，你的明白？”
语气中带着一丝威严。
“什么，你，你，你，你个王7+1，你竟然对兄弟的老婆下手，你是畜生啊”
老毕登怒道。
“兄弟何至如此啊，你我可是异父异母的亲兄弟，你要接受现实，生活就是这样，每天都有新的打击。”
姜云天回击。
“不经打击老天真，屡受打击必成神，有大哥我助你，你必成神”
姜云天接着道。
老毕登被震惊了吼道：“我从未见过如此厚颜无耻之人！
！”
姜云天之所以有恃无恐告诉老毕登这个残酷的现实，是有他的思考的，这些天以来，老毕登一直想要借助青鸳内衣中的含有精血的玉牌出云修练，增强神魂。
按照老毕登的脾性，如果出不去，他会毫不犹豫的压制住姜云天的灵魂，借用他的身体与青鸳说话，可是并没有。
因为认了姜云天做大哥，而恭恭敬敬，那更不可能，从老毕登的态度来说，没一丝一毫的恭敬可言。
那就可以断定老毕登不是不想而是不能，因为四人是灵体，想要自由行动，系统放任老毕登修练神魂，那说明老毕登的魂力增加，可能对系统也是有利的，既然系统支持老毕登离体修练神魂，那就说明确实需要媒介才能修练，而其他三个没有出去，或者说不能出，那就说明媒介是一个必要条件。
在系统的支持下，老毕登却不占用他的身体，那只能说明一种，老毕登一定尝试占用他的身体，而没有成功，那就只有一种解释：他体内有克制或是压制老毕登魂力的神秘力量，不难猜到，一定是小树苗的神秘力量，从小树苗进入体内的时间，也可以断定这一点。
至于系统为什么不支持老毕登，可能是系统看到了他的天赋，所图更大。
至于小树苗现在力量，应该没有表现的有多强大，不足以引起系统的重视。
想到此处，姜云天心下了然，气定神闲。
“你个无耻之徒，我要与你同归于尽！

！”
老毕登怒道
“怎么个同归于尽法？”
姜云天淡然道。
“我自爆灵体，炸死个小瘪三！
！”
“你爆个我看看！”
姜云天笑道。
姜云天心想，就你们四个打工人，要是想自爆就自爆，系统还不早就炸了。
还轮到你来发威。
果然，系统机械声响起“你爆个我看看！
！”
语气虽然僵硬，但戏谑与霸气却是听得出来。
content_en:
As soon as I entered the system, I heard Old Bidden's voice first: "Brother, big brother, you are finally here. I have been waiting for you for how many days. Why did you come? Little Yuanyuan's little inner, didn't you hang it on the window? Why can't I get out? Brother, big brother, I miss my little Yuanyuan."
"Your little Yuanyuan? Don't be rude. From now on, you will be called Sister-in-law Qingyuan. Do you understand?"
There was a hint of authority in his tone.
"What, you, you, you, you king 7+1, you actually attack your brother's wife, you are a beast"
Old Biden said angrily.
"Why are brothers like this? You and I are half-brothers. You have to accept the reality. Life is like this. There are new blows every day."
Jiang Yuntian fired back.
"If you don't get hit, you will become a god. If you are hit repeatedly, you will become a god. If you have a big brother and I will help you, you will become a god."
Jiang Yuntian continued.
Old Bidden was shocked and shouted: "I have never seen such a shameless person!
! "
The reason why Jiang Yuntian had the confidence to tell Old Bideng this cruel reality was because of his thinking. These days, Old Bideng has been trying to practice with the help of the jade brand Izumo containing blood essence in Qingyuan's underwear to strengthen his soul.
According to Old Biden's temperament, if he couldn't get out, he would not hesitate to suppress Jiang Yuntian's soul and use his body to talk to Qingyuan, but he didn't.
It was even more impossible for him to treat Jiang Yuntian respectfully because he recognized Jiang Yuntian as his eldest brother. Judging from Old Biden's attitude, there was no trace of respect at all.
Then it can be concluded that Old Biden does not want to but cannot, because the four of them are spirits and want to move freely. The system allows Old Biden to practice the soul. This means that the increase in Old Biden's soul power may also be beneficial to the system. Since the system supports the old Biden to cultivate the soul out of the body, it means that a medium is indeed needed to practice. But the other three did not go out, or could not, which means that the medium is a necessary condition.
With the support of the system, Old Biden did not occupy his body, which can only mean one thing. Old Biden must have tried to occupy his body, but failed. There is only one explanation: there is a mysterious power in his body that restrains or suppresses Old Biden's soul power. It is not difficult to guess that it must be the mysterious power of the young sapling. This can also be concluded from the time when the young sapling entered the body.
As for why the system did not support Old Bidden, it may be that the system saw his talent and had bigger plans.
As for the current strength of the sapling, it probably doesn't appear to be powerful enough to attract the system's attention.
Thinking of this, Jiang Yuntian felt relieved and calmed down.
"You shameless person, I will die with you!
! "
Old Bidden said angrily
"How can we die together?"
Jiang Yuntian said calmly.
"I blew up my spirit body and killed this little brat!
! "
"Blow it up and let me see!"
Jiang Yuntian smiled.
Jiang Yuntian thought to himself, there are only four of you working as workers. If you want to blow yourself up, just blow yourself up, and the system will explode long ago.
It's your turn to show off your power.
Sure enough, the system's mechanical voice sounded, "Blow it up and let me see!"
! "
Although the tone was stiff, the teasing and domineering tone could be heard.
